summary: ING Groep N.V. furnished a Form 6-K attaching a press release updating progress on its €1.0 billion share buyback programme announced on 30 April 2026. During the week of 13-17 July 2026, the company repurchased 1,200,000 shares at an average price of €28.54 per share, for total consideration of €34.3 million. Cumulatively, 16,160,000 shares have been repurchased at an average price of €26.40, representing ~42.66% completion of the programme. The buyback aims to reduce share capital. Investors should monitor the pace of weekly repurchases and any programme adjustments.
